name: HC10a: Tested for TB LAM
description: Number of new ART clients with baseline CD4 &amp;amp;lt;200 who were tested for TB LAM during the reporting period calculated by - Tested for TB LAM: Identifies clients who initiated ART during the reporting period and had a baseline CD4 count below 200 cells/mm³. Among these clients, a person is counted if there is evidence of TB-LAM testing during the reporting period, either from the HIV ART Card or from TB-LAM test orders/results. Each client is counted once

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT s.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND s.baseline_cd4 REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
  AND CAST(s.baseline_cd4 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) < 200
  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results r
          WHERE r.patient_id = s.patient_id
            AND r.encounter_datetime >= :startDate
            AND r.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            AND r.test_concept_id = 165822
            AND r.test_value_concept_id IN (1065)
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results r
          WHERE r.patient_id = s.patient_id
            AND r.encounter_datetime >= :startDate
            AND r.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            AND r.test_concept_id = 165291
            AND r.test_value_concept_id IN (703, 664)
      )
  );
